note: Validates that the RTL is implementable on the device Tiny Tapeout's FPGA emulator uses, fits it, and meets the pixel clock. Built with -DSYNTH through fpga/fpga_top.v, which is the same entropy path the fpga workflow builds: nextpnr-ice40 refuses a design containing a combinational loop, and an FPGA cannot host a usable ring oscillator TRNG out of routed LUTs anyway, so entropy arrives on ENT_IN. This run uses no PCF and its own board wrapper, so it is not a substitute for the fpga workflow, which builds Tiny Tapeout's tt_fpga_top and their FabricFox pin assignment. achieved_mhz is the register to register frequency, which is what decides whether the design runs. clk_to_pad_ns is the unconstrained clock to output pad delay, which exceeds one pixel period here; on a real board that path needs pin constraints and probably an output register stage.
